target: mchod par byed cing rgyal po chen po khyod bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas par gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma la snying brtse ba'i phyir/ rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan na/ tshe 'di nyid la bdag gi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par 'phel bar bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ de nas rgyal po chen po dpung dang / g.yog dang / gnod sbyin brgya stong phrag du ma dang bcas pa khyed bzhi lha dang lha ma yin du g.yul 'gyed pa na rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ / lha ma yin rnams pham par 'gyur ro/ / 'di ltar gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad 'dul bar byed pa 'di'i phyir/ rgyal po chen po khyed bzhi dpung dang g.yog tu bcas pa gnod sbyin stong phrag du ma la snying brtse ba'i phyir rtag par rgyun du gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di nyan na/ rim gro bgyi/

head: rājan
target: rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de thams cad la yang zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla na med pa bgyid 'tshal bar 'gyur/ rgyal po'i pho brang spos chab sna tshogs kyis chag chag gdab cing / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor na gnas pa'i lha thams cad kyang ches gzi brjid dang ldan pa dang / ches stobs dang ldan pa dang / bde ba dang yid bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par 'gyur/ dga' ba sna tshogs myong bar 'gyur/ ji ltar na 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi rgyal pos rgyal po nyid bgyi ba dang / ji ltar sems can thams cad bde bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar rang gi yul kun tu bsrungs par 'gyur ba dang / yongs su bskyangs par 'gyur ba dang / /

head: avakṛ

head: yakṣa
target: da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de dag dang / yul 'khor de dag dang / yul de dag kyang kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ / mtshang mi 'dru/ da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam dgra zla 'dab nye ba'i rgyal po de 'di snyam du bdag dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang lhan cig tu yul der song ste/ bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma chos nyan pa 'di dang chos bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis tshim par mi bgyid/
